info.title: customer-service customer route register (Customer V4 §23)
info.description: Mounted customer-family routes that had no OpenAPI document. Every operation is derived from the registered gin route and its handler source (request DTO fields, query and header reads); no field is hand-authored. Response bodies use the platform success/error envelope.

ServiceHMAC.name: X-Service-Signature
ServiceHMAC.description: HMAC v2 service auth: X-Service-Name, X-Service-Timestamp, X-Service-Nonce and X-Service-Signature; exact caller allowlist; replayed nonce refused.
